title: Trump-Backed Moore Captures Alabama GOP Senate Nomination
author: Sarah Jenkins
image: /images/news/Moore Wins Alabama Senate Runoff, Secures Republican Nomination.webp
excerpt: Trump-backed Moore won Alabama’s Republican Senate runoff election, securing the party’s nomination in a race that will help shape the battle for control of the U.S. Senate.

title: House Approves $70 Billion Immigration Enforcement Bill After Months of Republican Delays
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: The U.S. House narrowly approved a $70 billion immigration enforcement bill funding ICE and Border Patrol through 2029, delivering a major victory for President Donald Trump's immigration agenda.

title: Barack Obama Opens Presidential Center on Chicago’s South Side
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Former President Barack Obama officially opened the Obama Presidential Center in Chicago, unveiling a landmark campus dedicated to civic engagement, community development and preserving his presidential legacy.

title: Democratic National Committee Autopsy Report Blames Strategic Failures for Kamala Harris’s 2024 Defeat
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: The Democratic National Committee released its long-delayed report on Kamala Harris’s 2024 defeat, blaming strategic failures, weak voter outreach, and messaging problems.

title: Todd Blanche Emerges as Leading Candidate to Head U.S. Justice Department
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: President Donald Trump indicated that Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche could become the permanent head of the Justice Department, fueling speculation about a formal nomination.

title: John Cornyn Faces Tough Challenge From Trump-Backed Ken Paxton in Texas GOP Runoff
author: Emily Rodriguez
excerpt: Texas Republicans head into a high-profile Senate runoff between John Cornyn and Trump-backed Ken Paxton in a race with major national implications for the GOP.

title: South Carolina Republicans Block Effort to Redraw James Clyburn District
author: David Smith
excerpt: South Carolina Republicans blocked a Trump-backed redistricting proposal targeting Congressman James Clyburn’s district, exposing divisions inside the GOP ahead of the 2026 midterms.
